Perindoprilat, the closest ACE-inhibitor active-acid analog, reached 30 ± 6% systemic availability after oral perindopril in cirrhotic patients, but L2 context indicates normal volunteers had 19 ± 7% after prodrug administration, limiting direct transfer to the query's no-condition setting.
Phenylbutyric acid has 78% absolute oral bioavailability in humans, supporting absorption of small aromatic carboxylic acids.
